brief.question: How can a Proxyman-style desktop POC show live GraphQL and REST traffic with copy/share URL and cURL, repeat, Map Local (including a linked fixture file), Breakpoints and a Log Dashboard, and what are the original's real defaults and rules?
brief.purpose: The person wants to learn how Proxyman's Map Local, Breakpoint and Log dashboard pieces fit, and build a working POC in Rust/egui.
constraints: Deep mode: the original may be opened and decompiled, but never run or modified
Build only inside app/; everything else is read-only
Rust + eframe/egui; build must succeed and --screenshot must produce a non-blank PNG
Never change host macOS proxy settings without explicit confirmation
brief.done_when: The app builds, draws a real window, captures or simulates GraphQL and REST calls, copies URL/cURL, repeats, serves Map Local from inline JSON or a linked file, pauses at breakpoints, shows a log dashboard, passes its tests, and rebuild_check reports it would pass.

plan.title: Read the original's menus, tables and defaults
plan.why: ProxymanCore defaults initialiser 0xf34bc and the English .strings tables fix the port, compose timeout, abort menu, copy formats and rule order.

plan.title: Write the mechanics sheet and JSON
plan.why: app/MECHANICS.md and app/mechanics.json now record 29 values, every one with a source.

plan.title: Add the Breakpoint Abort-by modes
plan.why: Drop / 503 / 429, with Drop as the original's default; the proxy drops the socket or answers a JSON error.

plan.title: Add Compose timeout, share formats and Map Local delay presets
plan.why: 15/30/60/Off timeout passed to curl, HTTPie/Postman/HAR in the share sheet, the original's eight delay presets plus a 20 MB fixture warning.

plan.title: Decompile the per-key getters and the cURL/label builders
plan.why: 0x42858, 0x42f8c, 0x42960, 0x43050, 0x42e68, 0x42e04, 0x421cc and 0x40a20 settle the defaults; 0x2cd188 and 0x28fe9c settle cURL and GraphQL labels.

plan.title: Apply the decompiled values in the Rust POC
plan.why: New model constants, live proxy in cURL, -L follow-redirects default, 2-space indentation, 10 ms delay default, 60 s ceiling, 20 MB threshold.

plan.title: Build, test and photograph the new controls
plan.why: Clean build, 92 tests pass, and verify-mechanics.png confirms the Follow chip and inspector draw.

plan.title: Check the build against the original and update the handoff
plan.why: rebuild_check reports build, screenshot and mechanics all passed (29 sourced values), and says this would pass.

findings.statement: The original registers its proxy port as 9090 (`w8 = 0x2382` next to the CurrentProxyPort key) in the one defaults initialiser at 0xf34bc, which is why the POC's default is 9090.
The same initialiser writes `w8 = 0x1e` (30) for `composeTimeoutConfig`, so Compose's default send timeout is 30 seconds; the POC's 30 s default and 15/60/Off presets follow it.

Map Local's default response delay comes from its own small default function at 0x40c9c, which registers mapLocalResponseDelay = 10 (milliseconds), not seconds; the POC keeps the value in ms and applies the eight DelayTimePreset presets on top.

Map Local's delay menu is the Swift enum DelayTimePreset, whose contiguous cases are noDelay, oneSecond, twoSeconds, threeSeconds, fiveSeconds, tenSeconds, thirtySeconds and sixtySeconds, with a typed customDelayTimeMs field. The POC uses exactly that list and treats the last preset (60 000 ms) as the ceiling for typed values, replacing its earlier 10 s clamp.

The original's BreakpointAbortOption cases are dropConnection, return503 and return429, in that order, and the defaults initialiser stores raw 0 for breakpointAbortOption — so a fresh install aborts a breakpoint by dropping the connection, not by answering 503.

Compose's "Automatically Follow Redirects" switch is on by default: the getter at 0x43050 returns true for isComposeFollowRedirects, and the defaults initialiser 0xf34bc writes 1. The POC's Composer now starts with the switch on and passes -L to curl.

The embedded request editor uses 2-space indentation: 0x42960 returns 2 for monacoEditorTabSize and the defaults initialiser writes the same 2. The POC's cURL/code pretty-printers now use that constant instead of four spaces.

Map Local's large-fixture warning is a real 20 MB comparison in function 0x1bb608, whose message is the string at 0xfb01b0: "File size is bigger than 20Mb could impact the performance!". The POC uses 20 * 1024 * 1024 bytes for the same check.

The original's cURL generator (0x2cd188) always appends --proxy http://localhost:<port>, sends inline bodies as --data-binary @- and file bodies as --data-binary "@<path>", adds the multipart Content-Type header itself and recomputes Content-Length. The POC's Copy as cURL now includes the live proxy by default and omits the stale Content-Length.

GraphQL matching reads the operation name from the graphQLQueryName body key (helper 0x4bdd4); the label builder at 0x28fe9c falls back to the literal <Missing Query Name> when it is absent. The POC keeps the same key and fallback text.

Map Local's linked-fixture auto-save is on by default: 0x421cc returns true for isAutoSaveOnMapLocalFile. The POC is not claiming the original's 2-second debounce from code, only that the switch starts enabled.

handoff:
DONE: Proxzy is a complete Rust/egui POC for the requested Proxyman-style workflow. It has a real local HTTP/1.1 + HTTPS MITM gate on 127.0.0.1:9090 (9091-9093 fallback), live traffic list and inspector, copy URL/cURL/HTTPie/Postman/HAR/Markdown share, repeat, Composer for GraphQL and REST with cURL import and 15/30/60/Off timeout, Map Local with wildcard/GraphQL matching, three Success/Error/Empty scenarios, delay presets, linked fixture file, dynamic {{TOKEN}} injection and scenario switching, Breakpoints with request/response stages, editable method/URL/headers/body and Drop/503/429 abort modes, and a Log Dashboard with KPI cards, traffic chart, status families, top hosts, filters and session summary.

THIS PASS: decompiled the per-key getters in ProxymanCore and wired their values into the build. NEW EVIDENCE + FINDINGS fnd_6..fnd_11: compose follow-redirects defaults true (0x43050 + 0xf34bc); editor tab size 2 (0x42960); 20 MB fixture warning is a real compare with the string "File size is bigger than 20Mb could impact the performance!" at 0xfb01b0 from 0x1bb608; cURL builder 0x2cd188 always appends --proxy http://localhost:<port>, uses --data-binary @- / @file, adds multipart Content-Type and recomputes Content-Length; GraphQL key graphQLQueryName (0x4bdd4) with <Missing Query Name> fallback (0x28fe9c); Map Local auto-save default true (0x421cc). fnd_3/fnd_4 corrected: the preset list IS settled and 60 s is now the typed-delay ceiling. Code changes: app/src/model.rs constants + curl_with_proxy + 2-space indentation + AbortMode::default derived from BREAKPOINT_ABORT_OPTION_DEFAULT; app/src/app.rs composer_follow_redirects and run_curl(-L) and live proxy port in inspector; app/src/views.rs Follow chip and share-sheet cURL; app/src/proxy.rs delay default 10 ms and ceiling 60 s; app/src/rules_ui.rs 20 MB threshold; app/src/studio_ui.rs run_curl call.

VERIFIED this pass: cargo build clean (no warnings); 92 tests pass; --screenshot writes app/shots/verify-mechanics.png (2880x1664, 1.55 MB, non-blank with the Follow chip visible); rebuild_check reports build passed, app-screenshot passed, mechanics 29/29 sourced, 0 estimated, and "This would pass."

TRAPS: views.rs, rules_ui.rs, studio_ui.rs, tour_ui.rs, acp.rs and acp_ui.rs are include!d from app.rs; never add mod declarations. Only edit app/. Never run the GUI interactively or networksetup. Use ./app/target/debug/proxzy --screenshot app/shots/<name>.png from the repo root. The decompiler fell back to the built-in lifter (deep_engine_unavailable), so register-level pseudo-C is inferred, not exact; all cited values are single constants confirmed by a matching getter.

UNKNOWNS left open: exact original pixel layout/colours (unk_47215454465baff4); Local Directory tree mapping (unk_7ff0c3d300872480); live response-stage breakpoint pause is still simulated; regex matching and gist publishing are not implemented; exact GraphQL panel arrangement (unk_22889b3d43a9fb64). Documented, not silently omitted. NEXT: if asked, implement Proxyman's Local Directory mapping or a live response-stage pause.
